title: TarGEN: Targeted Data Generation with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting and comparing the distribution of Geopolitical Entities (GPE) tokens (such as countries and cities) between original and synthetically generated datasets using Spacy named-entity recognition.
Extracting and comparing the distribution of NORP (Nationalities or Religious or Political groups) tokens between original and synthetically generated datasets using Spacy named-entity recognition.

Evaluating model performance on a synthetically generated version of the Winogender Diagnostics (AX-g) task, which tests gender pronoun coreference resolution and gender-agnostic hypothesis generation.
